steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Beep boop... aaaand crash. Game over!
The simulated battle collapses. Red pulses across the screen as awkwardness fills the room, and hushed whispers start spreading among the spectators.

steps.speaker: Lambert
steps.content: Huh...? This... this shouldn't... The calculations were all sound... I-I'll just... check again. Adjust the parameters a little, and give it one more try...

Shock. Embarrassment. Then dread, anxiety, until even fear flickers across his features. The color drains from his face. He shakes as he desperately fiddles with the equipment, completely at a loss. The sight of an elderly man in such distress pricks at your conscience.
But the feeling doesn't last. Something else creeps in to replace it.
You catch the whispers drifting around you, growing ever more unguarded.

steps.speaker: Distinguished Guest B
steps.content: A bug? At an exhibition of this caliber? Some "academic lead" this guy is... Probably the same old racket. Academic cliques, ghost authorship, grant fraud... People say the Ring Research Institute has fallen on hard times, but I didn't think it was this bad.

steps.speaker: Distinguished Guest A
steps.content: First author: Lambert. Second author: Isomer... You've got to be joking. The old man clearly doesn't have the faintest idea what this project is about. I bet he just slapped his name onto his former student's work... Heh, at his age. Pathetic.

steps.speaker: Distinguished Guest B
steps.content: And the real first author couldn't even be bothered to show? We had to set work aside to come here on our own time, yet there's not a single person worth meeting. Is this really how the Ring Research Institute does business?

Isolated on that stage, the trembling professor looks like someone thrust under a spotlight for a public sentencing, completely defenseless. His expression is now hollow with panic, reduced to nothing more than a plain old man.

steps.speaker: Lambert
steps.content: I can fix this... I have to... otherwise...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Don't make a scene here, Chief. You said it yourself, we can't blow our cover, can't tip them off. So stop worrying about these idiots.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: None of this sits right with me. This is the highest seat of learning, a temple of knowledge, supposedly. Whatever else he may be, he's still a professor who dedicated his life to research and contributed to society... How could they treat him like this?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Tsk... Looks like you still have some romantic ideas about science. Let this genius set you straight: open your eyes and take a good look. Science is a battlefield for geniuses. It's as ruthless as it gets. Reality is brutal.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Same as a calculation. Either it works or it doesn't. There's no in-between. In the end, only the top geniuses get to stand at the cutting edge. As for the ones with zero talent who still refuse to step aside...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Most of them are just parasites chasing fame, clout, power. The kind that leech off everything and contribute nothing. Pests like that bring their own disgrace on themselves. No point feeling sorry for them.
The chill in her expression stuns you. Words completely fail you for a beat.
The old professor is still floundering up there. The crowd's mockery grows louder in response.

steps.speaker: Distinguished Guest A
steps.content: Why would Professor Isomer send him here? The Director ought to take responsibility for her own research, and not dump someone on us who doesn't know what he's talking about.

steps.speaker: Distinguished Guest B
steps.content: This glory-hound old fossil needs to step down already. We came to see the paper's real author. Just where is Isomer?
The questions come thick and hostile until a voice rises from the back of the room, strangely discordant with the rest.

steps.speaker: Unexpected Voice
steps.content: Would having the <color=#fb9259>first author</color> here be enough to satisfy you all?
Summer raises an eyebrow.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Woah—she actually showed up...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: First author...?

The wall of bodies stirs, yet the trespassers are still completely concealed. It's not until they've slipped free of the crowd, crossed into the light, and taken the stage that you see them. That's when the surprise lands.
Standing there is not a single figure. It's a group. Small in stature, unformed, still carrying the soft edges of youth—
Children.
[CG: Genius Children's Entrance]

Mania Dimension Core Research Team
BR-003 Observation Hub
By Invitation of the Ring Research Institute Director

The old professor finally jolts back to awareness. Watching the children mount the stage and approach, a whole spectrum of feelings runs through his face. Whether elation or horror holds the upper hand, you couldn't say.
He moves away from the podium, pulled toward them by instinct.

steps.speaker: Lambert
steps.content: ...Did... Isomer send you...
The only answer he receives is an icy glare from the blonde girl at the front.

steps.speaker: Blonde Girl
steps.content: The presentation was already watered down to the most basic level. And you still messed up.

steps.speaker: Blonde Girl
steps.content: Step aside, "Professor."

Lemma Herzfeld
Age 17 · Core Research Team · 4 Years with the Team
Specializes in: Mania analysis and application across multiple domains, with particular focus on theoretical research in Mania dimensions.
The blonde girl flicks him a single, dismissive glance and sweeps past without pause.

Enya Colitz
Age 17 · Core Research Team · 2 Years with the Team
Specializes in: Information engineering and data analysis, coordinating the cleaning, integration, and analysis of multi-source data within the team.

Sarah
Age 15 · Core Research Team · 3 Years with the Team
Specializes in: Dimensional superposition experiments, responsible for experimental procedure design, equipment calibration, and technical verification.

Barrie Field
Age 16 · Core Research Team · 2 Years with the Team
Specializes in: Numerical simulation and model construction for Mania fields, with a strong aptitude for translating theoretical hypotheses into computable solutions.
It's at this moment that Celine's words come rushing back to you.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: If you can't meet Director Isomer in person, don't let that trouble you. Under her wing, there's a group of people intimately tied to BR-003, the very subject you're investigating.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: They're top-tier geniuses, handpicked by the Director herself. Every one of them passed EDGE's vetting. Together, they form the core technical team at the BR-003 Observation Hub.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: That, right there, is how she does it. The Director can throw herself into every power struggle under the sun and still never lose her footing in academia.
